symptom: Mobile QA reports /soul-forge opens but shows no hero cards, no panels, no usable UI (only the header bar is visible).

root_cause_primary.description: The previous SF_MERGE Track B pack converted the body layout from horizontal split to a vertical column stack ('body: { flex: 1, flexDirection: column, padding: 6, gap: 6 }') but FORGOT to assign flex/height to the two child panels. gridPanel only declares 'gap: 4' and forgePanel only declares 'width: 100%'. Neither has flex nor an explicit height. Result:
consequence_grid_panel: gridPanel collapses to intrinsic min height (~14px just for the gridHeader)
Inside it, gridScroll declares 'flex: 1' BUT its parent has no bounded height, so the ScrollView renders at height 0
Therefore the hero cards never appear on screen even though heroes array is populated
consequence_forge_panel: forgePanel has no flex assignment, so it sizes to its content only
Its child forgePanelInner declares 'flex: 1' but the parent provides no bounded height, so the LinearGradient collapses
The inner ScrollView (added by SF_MERGE Track B for reachability) has paddingBottom 40 but with collapsed parent it shows almost nothing

root_cause_secondary.description: Inside the breakdown <Text> of the confirm modal, the bullet and star characters are written as escape sequences (\u2022, \u2605) directly in JSX text content. Since JSX text between > and < is taken literally, these render as the raw 6-character strings '\u2022' and '\u2605' rather than the bullet/star glyphs.
root_cause_secondary.severity: cosmetic (does NOT cause the blank screen but compounds the broken UX inside the confirm modal)

supporting_evidence: File pre-fix has only ONE outer container hierarchy: LinearGradient > header View + body View(flex column)
There is NO outer ScrollView wrapping the body, so the page is intrinsically non-scrollable on mobile portrait
Inside body, BOTH children depend on flex sizing they never receive
Children that internally use flex:1 (gridScroll, forgePanelInner) require a bounded parent height to render correctly in React Native; otherwise they collapse to 0

track_B_restore_visible_screen: Replace the broken vertical column body with a top-level ScrollView wrapping the entire content below the header
Remove the inner gridScroll ScrollView (avoids nested ScrollView height issues); render hero grid as a wrapping View
Remove flex:1 from forgePanelInner (let it size to content; outer ScrollView handles scrolling)
Add explicit loading/error/empty states so the screen is NEVER blank even if API calls fail or return empty arrays
Add bottom safe-area inset padding for final FORGE button reachability on 390x844 and 360x800 viewports
track_C_filters_and_grid: Add quick rarity filter controls: Tutti / Solo 1-3 stelle (safe) / Solo 4+ stelle / per-star chips
Keep existing protection: 4+ heroes still require explicit override toggle before they become selectable
track_D_modal_mobile_fix: Wrap confirm modal content in a vertical ScrollView so it scrolls when keyboard opens
Add KeyboardAvoidingView around the modal card on iOS/Android
Fix the raw escape literals on line 458 by using JSX expression containers
track_E_F_economy_import: Fetch /api/wallet, /api/soul-forge and /api/shops as READ-ONLY display sources
Show materials panel with prana, soul_seals, star_dust, soul_essence, plus quick view of global currencies
Show legacy soul forge shop preview in read-only mode (no live purchase actions)
All these reads are SAFE: GET endpoints, no mutation, no reward formula change
